proof_explanation: The repair correctly implements total Boolean negation by returning !value in the function body. The postcondition ensures result == !value is satisfied for all Boolean inputs: when value is false, the function returns true; when value is true, the function returns false. This establishes the required bijection between input and negated output, satisfying the law of total Boolean negation.

seeded_attack.reason: The seeded attack violates the Boolean negation law. Any implementation that fails to satisfy the postcondition ensures result == !value (such as the original buggy code that always returns false) does not achieve total Boolean negation and must be rejected.
